However, we have additional test cases from JSON; many overlap with existing tests, but some are not covered: cases about NaN and Infinity expectations differ from current test expectations. Indeed Math.abs(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY - Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY) = NaN, and NaN < 1e-12 is false. So existing test expects true; that is incorrect relative to method's behavior. The JSON expects false for Infinity case, and also for NaN case false. Also test expects false for Infinity vs finite etc.

Therefore we need to adjust tests accordingly. Perhaps we should replace existing Infinity test with correct expectations. Use parameterized test to cover many cases defined in JSON. Provide comments.

We should not modify @Before/@After, but we can add new test methods.
